purpose: Preregister the isolated, non-dynamical v2 model, state, pure force/JVP interface, deterministic timebase, observer-ownership, and accounting foundation required before WHCKL primitive implementation.

required_unchanged_sets: protected tags and their annotated targets

implemented: immutable model representation and canonical fingerprint
public inertial Cartesian, canonical Jacobi q-p, canonical Jacobi tangent dq-dp, and immutable observer-snapshot contracts
pure backend-independent force and JVP semantic interfaces
synthetic analytic force and JVP providers used by tests only
exact rational epoch and macro-step integer timebase
foundation documentation, traceability, and deterministic reporting
explicitly_deferred: all physical force and JVP implementations

implementation_requirements.V2-MODEL-001: BodyId is authoritative; CompiledLayout declares and validates one unique ordered ID for every body and a present central body.
implementation_requirements.V2-MODEL-002: The immutable model validates finite positive masses and constants, explicit units/effects/schema/provenance, defensive copying, and canonical deterministic serialization.
implementation_requirements.V2-MODEL-003: SHA-256 fingerprints change for every material model field and are independent of mapping insertion order, locale, hash seed, identity, and address.
implementation_requirements.V2-STATE-001: Distinct immutable public types encode inertial Cartesian x-v, canonical Jacobi q-p, and canonical tangent dq-dp semantics without implicit velocity-to-momentum conversion.
implementation_requirements.V2-STATE-002: State dimensions, finiteness, units, and layout fingerprints are validated; public storage retains no writable aliases.
implementation_requirements.V2-KERNEL-001: Pure force and JVP protocols are deterministic, side-effect free, layout checked, coordinate explicit, and keep force values distinct from JVPs.
implementation_requirements.V2-KERNEL-002: JVP output is semantically linear in tangent direction; foundations expose no hot-loop allocation promise or physical provider.
implementation_requirements.V2-TIME-001: Exact rational epoch and interval plus integer index define macro-step time directly; binary64 conversion occurs only at an explicit boundary.
implementation_requirements.V2-OWN-001: Live mutable state remains private; observers receive detached immutable snapshots and cannot influence future state or accounting.
implementation_requirements.V2-COUNT-001: Map-stage, corrector/synchronization, observer-only, and serialization/restart accounting domains are distinct typed values.
implementation_requirements.V2-DIAG-ANGLE-001: Finding G0-001 is carried forward: future orientation observers must use robust atan2 primary and chord cross-check, reject zero vectors, and never use the historical acos gate implementation.
implementation_requirements.V2-THRESH-SCOPE-001: Finding G0-002 is carried forward: a threshold-use contract must bind map, trajectory, tangent seed, normalization, coordinates, rescaling history, timestamps, and intended comparison class before compatibility can pass.
implementation_requirements.V2-ISOLATION-001: The v2 foundation imports neither REBOUND nor REBOUNDx, registers no import-time hooks, accesses no M0 globals, and exposes no integration or trajectory entrypoint.

G0-001.scope_note: Step 3g1a specifies and traces the observer contract; observer implementation remains deferred.

G0-002.scope_note: The foundation implements applicability typing only; it invents no scientific threshold.

model: BodyId uniqueness, explicit ordering, and central identity
unit, shape, mass, constant, and nonfinite rejection
state: coordinate type separation and q-p/dq-dp semantics
shape, finiteness, unit, and layout mismatch rejection
immutable public storage with no writable aliases
force_jvp: bitwise input preservation and no side effects
JVP linearity and exact zero-direction result
timebase: exact canonical round trip and hashing
negative and very large integer indices
invalid rational interval and bounds rejection
ownership: observer cannot obtain or return live state
typed accounting domains cannot be interchanged
isolation: no integration, timestep, trajectory, archive, MEGNO, LCN, or WHCKL primitive symbol
strict JSON, compile/import, deterministic regeneration, and git diff checks

acceptance_gates: every V2-MODEL, V2-STATE, V2-KERNEL, V2-TIME, V2-OWN, V2-COUNT, V2-DIAG, V2-THRESH, and V2-ISOLATION requirement has passing focused evidence
both Step 3g0 high findings have explicit requirements, tests, and traceability rows
all public APIs have docstrings, type annotations, and explicit invariants
fresh-process deterministic checks pass under multiple hash seeds and available locales
all inherited Manifest 21 hashes remain exact
no forbidden dynamics operation or production physical force evaluation occurs
complete review records and resolves every material foundation defect
summary, report, API specification, test inventory, traceability, and hash inventory agree
closeout commit leaves a clean worktree and descends from this preregistration

deterministic_regeneration.canonical_json: UTF-8, sorted keys, compact separators for hashed configuration payloads; strict finite JSON with sorted keys and two-space indentation plus trailing newline for reports.
deterministic_regeneration.csv: UTF-8, fixed column order, LF line endings, deterministic row ordering.
deterministic_regeneration.artifact_hashes: SHA-256 over exact file bytes; summary excludes its own hash.
deterministic_regeneration.fresh_process: Run artifact generation and canonical model/timebase probes in separate interpreters with at least two PYTHONHASHSEED values and available distinct locales; outputs must be byte-identical.

classification_rules.STEP3G1A_V2_FOUNDATION_COMPLETE: Every preregistered foundation contract and focused gate passes, protected evidence remains exact, no forbidden operation occurs, and closeout is clean.
classification_rules.STEP3G1A_V2_FOUNDATION_INCOMPLETE: Implementation or review completes but one or more preregistered requirements or gates remains unresolved without a baseline-integrity block.
classification_rules.STEP3G1A_BLOCKED: The required baseline, inherited evidence, branch state, no-dynamics guarantee, or required source/specification cannot be established.
classification_rules.V2_FOUNDATION_READY_FOR_PRIMITIVES: The isolated foundation is complete and supports beginning only the next preregistered primitive layer.
classification_rules.V2_FOUNDATION_NOT_READY: A specific unresolved foundation defect prevents primitive implementation.
classification_rules.V2_FOUNDATION_REQUIREMENTS_CONFLICT: Two frozen foundation requirements cannot both be satisfied without reinterpretation.

prohibited_operations: REBOUND or REBOUNDx simulation construction or import in v2
Kepler drift or kick map implementation or execution
Jacobi coordinate transform implementation or execution
lazy kernel, order-17 corrector, WHCKL step, or tangent-map composition
physical Solar-System force or JVP experiment

successor_boundary.allowed_only_after_success: Step 3g1b may implement only isolated inertial/Jacobi transforms and their canonical tangent maps.
